==Summary==

:{{pov|[[Perrin Aybara]]}}
Perrin watches everyone's reactions to [[Moiraine Damodred|Moiraine]]'s presence. Thom follows her in to Perrin's delight but he wonders where Mat is. She speaks briefly with [[Rand al'Thor|Rand]] and [[Egwene al'Vere|Egwene]] and is hugged by [[El'Nynaeve ti al'Meara Mandragoran|Nynaeve]], surprising Moiraine, but she then returns the hug. Moiraine quotes the [[Karaethon Cycle|prophecy]] and tells everyone they need to do what Rand wants because only he could fight this battle. [[Roedran Almaric do Arreloa a'Naloy|Roedran]] continues to interrupt, asking who Moiraine is, but each time he does he is silenced by a flick of air from either an [[Aes Sedai]] or [[Asha'man]] until he finally remains silent.  

A brown sister speaks up and says there is a problem with the treaty since it will be meaningless without the [[Seanchan (disambiguation)|Seanchan]] also signing the document. Elayne adds that without a mechanism for punishing those who breach the peace, the treaty would be viewed as null and war will result. Rand promises he will make peace with the Seanchan and if not the document would be void. [[Aviendha]] objects that the [[Aiel]] are not in the treaty and Rand has ''[[Ji'e'toh|toh]]'' towards them. Rand states he was showing them honor by trusting them but Aviendha demands her boon{{Ref/book|14|5}} - to put the Aiel in the [[Dragon's Peace]]. Rand protests but the other Aiel [[Wise One|Wise Ones]] confirm she speaks for them. [[Rhuarc]] speaks up to say their purpose was to train and be hardened in order to serve him but after the [[Last Battle]], they will need a new purpose. Rand finally agrees to put them in the treaty too.  Perrin asks to speak with him privately. After Rand weaves the ward, Perrin uses a metaphor of a tool that will rust if not used and proposes that Aiel should be used to enforce the treaty. Rand agrees and provides several amendments, one of which will be the Aiel as not only enforcers of criminals who cross borders, but mediators between nations, using Aiel justice. He offers these options to the Aiel, who accept after a brief discussion. The rulers also see the good in this as they believe the Aiel are savages and could be easily manipulated. Rand smiles to himself thinking he would like to see them try.  

Moiraine asks Rand why he would need to command the armies when he is going to [[Shayol Ghul]]. Rand agrees that someone else could lead the armies as long as the others know that there is just one Commander. Moiraine addresses Egwene and insists that the [[Amyrlin Seat|Amyrlin, the Watcher of the Seals]], should be the one who will break the [[Seven Seals|Seals]] and that the prophecy requires it. Egwene reluctantly agrees and Rand gives the Seals to Egwene. The rulers finally sign the document but [[Elayne Trakand|Elayne]] is the last. To persuade her, Rand suggests appointing her to lead the armies during the Last Battle. The other rulers debate amongst themselves but Rand persuades them she is a good choice and she agrees, then signs the document.   

Then they discuss the Seanchan, who still hold many Aiel Wise Ones as [[damane|''damane'']]. The Aiel chiefs want to start a [[Blood Feud|blood feud]], but Aviendha says they can't win and the other Wise Ones agree (based on the vision in [[Rhuidean]]{{ref/book|13|48}}. Finally, as everyone has signed the treaty, Rand declares he has some tasks before heading to Shayol Ghul. The sky seems to darken which worries Perrin. 

Before leaving the tent, Rand says there is [[Al'Lan Mandragoran|a dear friend]] in need of their help.

:{{pov|[[Al'Lan Mandragoran]]}}

Lan and his companions are desperately fighting the [[Shadowspawn]]. Though they still hold Tarwin’s Gap, the humans suffer many casualties and grow exhausted. Another raid begins and Lan orders his men to slowly begin pulling out of the pass, knowing the Trollocs will follow. Lan is aware they will eventually be overrun so his army charges the Trollocs stuck within the gap, ready to fight until death. Lan sends one last thought of love to Nynaeve and then shouts "''Al Chailidholara Malkier!" ''and hears thousands of hoofbeats behind him. He turns to see men riding through a gateway under the flag of [[Arafel]]. More gateways open and the other [[Borderlands|Borderlanders]] appear together with [[Asha'man]]. Lan laughs, [[Malkier]] won't die today.
